For over 85 years, Long Close has enjoyed a small, close-knit family community which makes a big difference. Our bespoke skills-first academic excellence provides essential preparation for our students to thrive in the rapidly evolving 21st century workplace. Our students are happy, well-rounded and impressive young people. We know they love being part of the Long Close family every day and we are proud to be inspiring future leaders.
PEGASUS
Our wonderful school was founded in 1941, and PEGASUS has been our steadfast motif for over eighty years. The majestic, winged horse from Greek mythology encompasses beauty, inspiration and the pursuit of academic excellence; highflying PEGASUS is a powerful symbol for all our students to live up to our school motto, altiora petimus – to soar higher without limits.

pageCache.pageTitle: Admissions | Visit & Join Long Close School in Slough
pageCache.text:
Admissions
Join us for our Open Morning
Friday 25th September 2026
We warmly invite you to a talk with our Headteacher at 10am, followed by tours of the school from 10.30am. Whether you are looking for a Nursery, Prep or Senior School place, come along and see our whole school in action, and experience our vibrant school community for yourself.
We offer taster days to every family and we also offer dedicated open mornings.
Key Information for Prospective Families
Fees
Healthy food choices
After school club
Uniform

Co-Curricular
Enhancing students' experiences
At Long Close School, we understand the importance of providing a supportive and nurturing environment beyond the regular school day. Our After School programme offers a safe and engaging space for students to unwind, explore, and continue their learning journey.
Supervised by our dedicated staff, students have the opportunity to participate in a variety of enriching activities, from arts and crafts to sports and games.
Whether it's completing homework or simply enjoying some downtime with friends, our After School programme ensures that every child feels cared for and valued, fostering a sense of belonging within our school community. Parents can have peace of mind knowing that their children are in capable hands, extending the Long Close experience into the afternoons with a focus on fun, learning, and building lasting memories.
Care beyond school hours
